# Input

Create a concise GBIA user story and a business-demo UAT package from confirmed requirements. Reuse the project constraints, do not invent adjacent behavior, do not split ownership without confirmation, and do not expand demo coverage into a full regression suite.

The expected contract resolves source authority, deliverable mode, story responsibility, baseline target, and project preferences before authoring. It removes irrelevant sections and uses source-backed, risk-based AC and UAT coverage.
